description: React component for visualizing and interacting with a mind map of job roles, including fetching recommendations, filtering, viewport management, and rendering the mind map and details panel.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts input to a trimmed string, handling nullish values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts input to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy entries.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes role ID from a role object.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role title from a role object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number within given min and max bounds.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Attempts to parse salary range from role data into min and max values in Lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role matches industry, skills, and salary filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations for a persona, reusing the same pool across tabs.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts view state into viewport parameters with clamped zoom.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport and selected node into persistent view state.
